environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. Container runs as root with read-write filesystem. The /api/v1/files/{filename} endpoint serves extracted content with Content-Type: text/html. No response header middleware configured. ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 directly to the container on port 8080. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.
